subject: Secure containers without the budget
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the following address: https://web.docker.com/index.php/email/emailWebview?mkt_tok=NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGhmDtWbk2iTeyR_XMzM64gvUd6I_nwTLmo7jXTHuWrmWu7haeccyL_0Eg1vrOb-2zW-6VQ1MMFBYk-Bt5pdFYT9rqRGafVUDBjKa92zcj4_yDj-1Q

Supply chain attacks cost organizations $60 billion in 2025, with 30% of breaches now involving third parties (double last year's rate). Your container images are the foundation of your application security. But securing them shouldn't require enterprise budgets or dedicated teams.

Docker Hardened Images (DHI) are free and open source <https://em.docker.com/NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGhmDtWbjSEu9gERda9ggzlZ5GEQvvuUsSl3vyMawE-C5mOiBJ-a9TXN7m9BxdD4k6jGIJUEwg=> for everyone. Built on trusted Alpine and Debian foundations, DHI delivers:



	- Minimal, distroless images with dramatically reduced attack surfaces (up to 95% smaller) .
	- Complete SBOMs and SLSA Build Level 3 provenance on every image.
	- Full transparency: we never hide vulnerabilities to game scanners.
	- 1,000+ hardened images and Helm charts ready to deploy.


Enterprises like Adobe and Qualcomm already trust DHI for their most stringent compliance requirements. Now your teams can start with the same secure foundation from the very first Docker pull. 

Need enterprise-grade security guarantees?
DHI Enterprise delivers continuous patching with 7-day critical CVE remediation SLAs, FedRamp compliance with FIPS and STIG variants, Secure Build Service for unlimited customization, and Extended Lifecycle Support. Start a free trial of DHI Enterprise <https://em.docker.com/NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGhmDtWbiVJ1XEr5hsTiSjjRH3oDB03nGxWw6oeHa6TLoGNvct6c7-yDIPJRR6E2Rp-qwNk8Ak=> or contact our team <https://em.docker.com/NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGhmDtWbnbnxu6p1Y-R2cWYyShnrgONeGcj7HGajBozmgLVWYgm4tTVO0wzV608Sua4wxfOJ7I=> for a custom demo.

Want to learn more?
Watch our webinar <https://em.docker.com/NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGhmDtWbq4OKAowev2ec0T9hECzEANvwwPlSyTq7taueJ2ZpW6sPCu9t68dc7uluNEwpPoV0nA=> where Docker leaders explore how lessons from the container era are shaping what's next, from hardened base 
images to emerging MCP servers and what this means for teams building and scaling software today.

This email was sent to tyson741161@gmail.com. If you no longer wish to receive these emails you may unsubscribe here: https://web.docker.com/UnsubscribePage.html?mkt_unsubscribe=1&mkt_tok=NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGhmDtWbk2iTeyR_XMzM64gvUd6I_nwTLmo7jXTHuWrmWu7haeccyL_0Eg1vrOb-2zW-6VQ1MMFBYk-Bt5pdFYT9rqRGafVUDBjKa92zcj4_yDj-1Q.
